```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(betterChromVAR)
  library(edgeR)
  library(BiocParallel)
  library(MotifDb)
  library(TFBSTools)
  library(universalmotif)
  library(memes)
  library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
  library(qsmooth)
  library(Hmisc)
  library(GenomeInfoDb)
})
verbose <- FALSE
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ETHZ-INS/DTFAB/refs/heads/main/Scripts/GCnorm.R")
counts <- function(se) assay(se,"counts")
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
bse <- readRDS("bulkATAC.SE.rds")
bse <- bse[rowSums(assay(bse))>0,]
assay(bse, "GCQN") <- GCQuantileNorm(bse)
assay(bse, "GCsmQN") <- GCSmoothQuantile(bse, bio="Group")
bse <- CVnorm(bse)
assay(bse, "CVnorm") <- assay(bse, "corrected")
bse <- CVnorm(bse, grouping = bse$Group)
assayNames(bse) <- gsub("^corrected$", "smCVnorm", assayNames(bse))
bse <- CVnorm(bse, grouping = bse$rndGroup, shrinkMode="qsmooth")
assayNames(bse) <- gsub("^corrected$", "qsmCVnorm", assayNames(bse))

mm <- model.matrix(~Sex+Group, data=as.data.frame(colData(bse)))
bse <- bse[filterByExpr(as.matrix(assay(bse)), mm),]
doAna <- function(a, mm){
  a <- a[which(rowSums(is.na(a))==0),]
  dge <- calcNormFactors(DGEList(a))
  dge <- estimateDisp(dge, mm)
  fit <- glmFit(dge, mm)
  as.data.frame(topTags(glmLRT(fit, "Group45min"), Inf))
}

res <- bplapply(assays(bse), BPPARAM=MulticoreParam(length(assays(bse)), progress=verbose), mm=mm, FUN=doAna)
saveRDS(res, file="Waag_results.rds")
nDARs <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(res, \(x) data.frame(nDARs=sum(x$FDR<0.05))), .id="method")

bse$stratum <- interaction(bse$Sex, bse$Group, drop=TRUE)

runOnePerm <- function(dummy, Obse, size=8){
  sp <- lapply(split(seq_len(ncol(Obse)), Obse$stratum), \(i){
    if(length(i)>size) i <- sample(i, min(length(i), size))
    i
  })
  bse <- Obse[,unlist(sp)]
  bse$rndGroup <- unlist(lapply(sp, function(i){
    sample(c("Split1", "Split2"), length(i), replace=TRUE)
  }), use.names = FALSE)
  mm <- model.matrix(~Sex+rndGroup, data=as.data.frame(colData(bse)))
  bse <- bse[filterByExpr(as.matrix(assay(bse)), mm),]
  assay(bse, "GCsmQN") <- GCSmoothQuantile(bse, bio="rndGroup")
  bse <- CVnorm(bse, grouping = bse$rndGroup)
  assayNames(bse) <- gsub("^corrected$", "smCVnorm", assayNames(bse))
  bse <- CVnorm(bse, grouping = bse$rndGroup, shrinkMode="qsmooth")
  assayNames(bse) <- gsub("^corrected$", "qsmCVnorm", assayNames(bse))
  lapply(assays(bse), \(a){
    a <- a[which(rowSums(is.na(a))==0),]
    dge <- calcNormFactors(DGEList(a))
    dge <- estimateDisp(dge, mm)
    fit <- glmFit(dge, mm)
    as.data.frame(topTags(glmLRT(fit, "rndGroupSplit2"), Inf))
  })
}

set.seed(123)
pres <- bplapply(1:30, BPPARAM=MulticoreParam(10, RNGseed=42, progress=verbose),
                 Obse=bse, FUN=runOnePerm)
saveRDS(pres, file="Waag_results_permutations.rds")

set.seed(123)
pres2 <- bplapply(1:30, BPPARAM=MulticoreParam(10, RNGseed=123, progress=verbose),
                 Obse=bse, FUN=runOnePerm, size=4)
saveRDS(pres2, file="Waag_results_permutations_small.rds")

nDARs.p <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(pres, \(d){
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(d, \(x){
    data.frame(nDARs=sum(x$FDR<0.05))
  }), .id="method")
}), .id="permutation")
nDARs.p2 <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(pres2, \(d){
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(d, \(x){
    data.frame(nDARs=sum(x$FDR<0.05))
  }), .id="method")
}), .id="permutation")

nDARs$type <- "real data (8vs8)"
nDARs$permutation <- 0
nDARs.p$type <- "permutations (8vs8)"
nDARs.p2$type <- "permutations (4vs4)"
nDARs$method[order(-nDARs$nDARs)]

m <- rbind(nDARs, nDARs.p, nDARs.p2)
m <- m[which(m$method != "norm"),]
m$method <- factor(m$method, as.character(nDARs$method[order(-nDARs$nDARs)]))
m$type <- factor(m$type, unique(m$type))
levels(m$method) <- gsub("^counts$", "raw", levels(m$method))
saveRDS(m, file="DAR_stats.rds")
```

```{r}
m <- readRDS("DAR_stats.rds")
```


```{r, fig.width=3, fig.height=5}
ggplot(m, aes(method, nDARs)) + geom_col(stat = "summary", fun = "mean") + 
  #geom_jitter(data=m[!grepl("real", m$type),], width = 0.2, height=0) + 
  stat_summary() +
  facet_wrap(~type, scale="free_y", ncol=1) + theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 90, hjust=1, vjust=0.5))
```

```{r}
DARs <- lapply(res, \(x) row.names(x)[which(x$FDR<0.05)])
new_DARs <- setdiff(unique(unlist(DARs[grep("CVnorm",names(DARs))])),
                    unique(unlist(DARs[grep("CVnorm",names(DARs), invert=TRUE)])))

motifs <- query(MotifDb, c("HOCOMOCOv13"))
motifs <- motifs[grepl("A$|B$",names(motifs))]
motifs <- do.call(PWMatrixList, convert_motifs(motifs, "TFBSTools-PWMatrix"))
names(motifs) <- sapply(motifs, \(x) x@name)
motifs <- motifs[!duplicated(names(motifs))]
```

```{r}
r <- rowRanges(bse)
seqlevelsStyle(r) <- "UCSC"
seqs <- getSeq(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10, r)
names(seqs) <- names(r)
ame <- memes::runAme(seqs[which(names(r) %in% new_DARs)], control=seqs,
                     database=convert_motifs(motifs), meme_path="/usr/bin/")
saveRDS(ame, file = "Waag_results_AME.rds")
```
